comment: IkeCertUtils provides utility methods for decoding byte array of Certificate and PrivateKey

methods.name: public static X509Certificate certificateFromByteArray(byte[] derEncoded)
methods.comment: Decodes an ASN.1 DER encoded Certificate

methods.name: public static RSAPrivateKey privateKeyFromByteArray(byte[] pkcs8Encoded)
methods.comment: Decodes a PKCS#8 encoded RSA private key
